title: Not Very Well
note: 英文人工 SRT 与中文翻译逐条对齐；纯音效/水印行已剔除。

lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother George,
lines.zh: 我是佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，

lines.en: this is Mummy Pig, and this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Peppa Pig.
Not very well.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig have just made breakfast for Peppa and George.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈和猪爸爸刚刚给佩奇和乔治做了早餐。

lines.en: Breakfast is ready!
Peppa has red spots on her face.
Not me, I don't feel very well.
lines.zh: 不是我，我感觉不太舒服。

lines.en: Oh dear Peppa, you don't look very well.
lines.zh: 哦亲爱的佩奇，你看起来不太好。

lines.en: Don't worry, I'll ring Doctor Brown Bear.
lines.zh: 别担心，我会给棕熊医生打电话。

lines.en: Doctor Brown Bear speaking.
Peppa is not very well. Her face is covered in red spots.
lines.zh: 佩奇不太好。她的脸上长满了红斑。

lines.en: Put Peppa to bed and I'll come straight round.
lines.zh: 把佩奇放到床上，我就过来。

lines.en: Doctor Brown Bear has come to make Peppa better.
lines.zh: 棕熊医生来让佩奇好起来。

lines.en: Hello Peppa, how are you today?
I'm not very well.
Stick your tongue out please.
It's not anything serious, Peppa has just got a rash.
lines.zh: 没什么大不了的，佩奇只是出了皮疹。

lines.en: Do I need medicine?
The rash will clear up quickly, but if you like I can give you just a little medicine.
lines.zh: 皮疹很快就会消失，但如果你愿意的话我可以给你一点药。

lines.en: Yes please.
I'm afraid it doesn't taste very nice. Open wide please.
lines.zh: 恐怕味道不太好。请张开。

lines.en: Eww, disgusting!
You are a brave little one for taking it so well.
lines.zh: 你是一个勇敢的小家伙，能如此顺利地接受它。

lines.en: Peppa must stay in bed. I'll call back later to check that she's better.
lines.zh: 佩奇必须留在床上。我稍后再打电话确认她是否好些了。

lines.en: Can Peppa have visitors?
Oh yes, she can have visitors. The rash isn't catching.
lines.zh: 哦，是的，她可以接待访客。皮疹没有传染。

lines.en: Goodbye.
Goodbye Doctor Brown Bear.
Mummy, can I get up now?
lines.zh: 妈妈，我现在可以起床了吗？

lines.en: Doctor Brown Bear says that you must stay in bed for a little bit, Peppa.
lines.zh: 棕熊医生说你必须在床上躺一会儿，佩奇。

lines.en: But it's so boring.
Doctor Brown Bear did say you could have visitors.
lines.zh: 棕熊博士确实说过你可以接待访客。

lines.en: Can Susie Sheep visit me?
lines.zh: 小羊苏西可以来看我吗？

lines.en: Susie Sheep is Peppa's best friend.
lines.zh: 小羊苏西是佩奇最好的朋友。

lines.en: I'll ring Susie Sheep's mummy.
lines.zh: 我给小羊苏西妈妈打电话。

lines.en: Hello Mrs Pig.
May Peppa talk with Susie please.
Hello Susie.
Hello Peppa.
I'm not very well. I have red spots on my face.
lines.zh: 我不太舒服。我脸上有红斑。

lines.en: Has the doctor been?
Yes, Doctor Brown Bear was here.
He said I wasn't very well and that I was very brave.
lines.zh: 他说我身体不太好，但我很勇敢。

lines.en: So are you really ill?
Yes, yes. It's not pretend. I have to stay in bed.
lines.zh: 是的，是的。这不是假装。我必须留在床上。

lines.en: Doctor Brown Bear gave me a bed he sent that tasted really horrible.
lines.zh: 棕熊医生给了我一张他寄来的床，味道真的很糟糕。

lines.en: I'm coming to see you.
I'm going to wear my nurse's outfit.
Susie Sheep has come to see Peppa.
Susie is wearing her nurse's costume.
Danny Dog and Rebecca Rabbit have come along too.
lines.zh: 狗丹尼和小兔瑞贝卡也来了。

lines.en: Hello Peppa.
Hello.
How do you feel?
I'm not very well, Susie. I have to stay in bed.
lines.zh: 我不太好，苏西。我必须留在床上。

lines.en: What can we do to make you better?
lines.zh: 我们能做些什么来让你变得更好？

lines.en: You could get me some orange juice.
Okay.
Peppa seems to be quite enjoying herself.
Thank you, Susie.
Do you feel any better?
A little bit.
Danny?
Ask my mummy if I could have some ice cream.
lines.zh: 问我妈妈是否可以吃点冰淇淋。

lines.en: And Rebecca, could you bring me some flowers from the garden?
lines.zh: 丽贝卡，你能给我从花园里摘一些花吗？

lines.en: Doctor Brown Bear is here to see if Peppa is better.
lines.zh: 棕熊医生来看看佩奇有没有好点。

lines.en: Ah, good. The nurse is already here. How is the patient?
lines.zh: 啊，很好。护士已经来了。病人怎么样？

lines.en: I'm not a real nurse. It's just pretend.
lines.zh: 我不是真正的护士。这只是假装而已。

lines.en: I see. Would you like me to take a look myself?
lines.zh: 我明白了。要我亲自去看看吗？

lines.en: Yes, please.
I say, no more red spots. You're completely better.
lines.zh: 我说，不再有红点了。你已经完全好了。

lines.en: Aren't I still a bit ill?
How do you feel?
I think I should stay in bed a little bit more.
lines.zh: 我想我应该在床上多呆一会儿。

lines.en: I fancy a game with this ball in the garden.
lines.zh: 我喜欢在花园里玩这个球的游戏。

lines.en: Who wants to join me?
Me, me, me.
Me too.
Well, I never. A complete recovery.
lines.zh: 嗯，我从来没有。完全康复。

lines.en: George, you're doing it all wrong.
This is how to catch a ball.
